title: Liu Yandong, Rare Woman Among China’s Political Elite, Dies at 80
summary_full: The former vice premier was one of just six women to have served on the Chinese Communist Party’s elite Politburo, though she was excluded from the top ranks of power.
summary_public: The former vice premier was one of just six women to have served on the Chinese Communist Party’s elite Politburo, though she was excluded from the top ranks of power.
